profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at VTA
profile.summary:
San Jose State University Alumni 2019.

My interests are Digital audio sequencers, web development and video games. My hobbies include volleyball, learning languages and traveling.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed driver application for 3D model rendering using C++ and the Vulkan API.
- Designed and implemented test plans for ray tracing modules including unit and integration tests.
- Managed software development and test implementations through GitHub and Azure Devops.
- Documented software designs, code changes and user guides for developed modules.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Full Stack Development in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, HTML and CSS
- Designed, developed, and tested a robust medical report track reopening system
- Refactored and enhanced existing modules to improve usability and maintainability
- Worked with the Client Solutions team to identify software defects to then fix and reship
- Collaborated in a cross-functional team of business analysts and project managers to define requirements and business value

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Graded homework assignments that consisted of ARM assembly code. Answered questions regarding the concepts in the homework.

volunteerExperiences.description: I assisted students in understanding concepts in beginning and intermediate C++ and Java programming, assembly, and data structures. I also helped students debug their code.

projects.title: Stock Portfolio Calculator
projects.description: Using 5 different investment strategies, determine how much to invest in certain stocks. This is implemented using PyQt GUI library and yfinance API.

projects.title: Wildfire Prediction Platform Cloud Solution
projects.description: A wildfire prediction software suite that allows a user to view wildfire prediction, detection and analysis features. Implemented using React, Firebase, MySQL and Tableau.
